$Comment: Scope-2 wave-3 leg W3-F (design section 2.7, decision 32 - jar layer, ZERO progression): STANDALONE-RICH by design - this station is fully useful on its own (a classic direct convert loop: place raw fish, press use, get grilled fish) AND doubles as the multi-station ANCHOR the cutting board's PrepFish program claims by proximity+type (Anchors:{fire:{Station:'cookingfire',...}} on Actions/PrepFish.json). When claimed as a remote anchor, THIS station's own action is never invoked (design 2.2) - only its Custody claim (the anchor's own placed-input slot) and its block's State.Definitions (Default/Lit) matter; the program's own Steps execute at this anchor with the fire's presentation. No Puppet group is authored here (mirrors the Sawmill precedent - a classic non-Walk convert loop needs no puppet route). Custody.States.Loaded='Lit' names the block's own lit-campfire state variant (RPG_Station_CookingFire.json). Custody.Display is the flat Fish_Piece-model item prop - the placed item's OWN BlockType.CustomModel/CustomModelTexture renders through the item-route prop automatically (Food_Fish_Raw / Food_Fish_Grilled both model Resources/Ingredients/Fish_Piece.blockymodel with a raw-vs-roasted texture swap baked into each item, ledger [6cdea5ead]), so this Display group only needs Offset/Scale, never a model reference - Offset.Y is a first-pass placeholder, PROVISIONAL/in-game-unverified like every other shipped Custody.Display in this family. SEAM WAVE (decision 51c/52) re-authors onto native recipe truth: Recipe.FromCrafting.Benches:['Campfire'] + Types:['Processing'] document the REAL native Food_Fish_Grilled recipe (Input:[{ItemId:'Food_Fish_Raw'}], BenchRequirement:[{Id:'Campfire',Type:'Processing'}], TimeSeconds:2, ledger [6cdea5ead]) - the native BenchRequirement here carries NO Categories field at all, so the Sawmill's Categories-only derivation route genuinely cannot reach this recipe, which is exactly why Benches exists as a second derivation route. The hand-authored Conversions[] block is KEPT and is what runs: the live station.StationRecipeDeriver now DOES derive from Benches (the seam-wave bench-id-route matching, decision 51c), but the derived Campfire twin shares this same input ref (Food_Fish_Raw), so the authored-conversion-wins dedup SUPPRESSES the derived twin - the hand-authored Conversion is the EFFECTIVE one, unchanged. NativeTime{Scale:1.0,OffsetMs:500} is the linear transform (decision 52, y=Scale*TimeSeconds_ms+OffsetMs) documenting the native pacing (1.0*2000+500=2500ms, matching Work.CycleMs below byte-for-byte); because the derived twin it would bake onto is suppressed by the authored Conversion, NativeTime is currently INERT (the authored Conversion carries no DurationMs, so Work.CycleMs stays the sole live cadence source). Dropping the authored Conversions[] would hand the recipe to the derived Benches conversion and let NativeTime take effect, at the same 2500ms pacing.
